# KernelSU iOS Emoji

Systemlessly replaces Android's emoji font with iOS 26.4 Emoji.

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji?label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji/releases/latest)
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji/total?label=Downloads&logo=github)](https://github.com/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji/releases)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji?label=Stars&color=blue)](https://github.com/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji)

## Download

[Download KernelSU_iOS-Emoji_26.4.zip](https://github.com/solivexy/KernelSU-iOS-Emoji/releases/download/26.4/KernelSU_iOS-Emoji_26.4.zip)

## Support

| Root manager | Status |
| --- | --- |
| KernelSU Next | Supported |
| KernelSU | Supported |
| Magisk | Supported |
| APatch | Supported |

Works on Android 10 through Android 16 QPR1. No metamodule is required.

## Install

1. Download the release ZIP.
2. Open KernelSU, KernelSU Next, Magisk, or APatch.
3. Install the ZIP from the manager's Modules screen.
4. Reboot.

## Features

- iOS 26.4 emoji font
- Direct mounting for KernelSU and KernelSU Next
- Magisk and APatch compatibility
- Gboard and system emoji replacement
- Facebook and Messenger emoji replacement
- Manual refresh through the module action button

## Troubleshooting

- Reboot after installing or updating.
- Make sure the module is enabled in your root manager.
- Clear your keyboard app cache if emojis do not change.
- Use the module action button to refresh emojis manually.
- Check logs in `/data/adb/modules/iOS_Emoji/` if something fails.
- Disable other font or emoji modules if there is a conflict.

## Updates

Update metadata:

- KernelSU/APatch: [`update.json`](update.json)
- Magisk: [`updater.json`](updater.json)

Changelog: [`Changelog.md`](Changelog.md)

## Credits

- Module by [solivexy](https://github.com/solivexy)
- Emoji font source: [samuelngs/apple-emoji-linux](https://github.com/samuelngs/apple-emoji-linux)
- Root platforms: [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU), [Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk), [APatch](https://github.com/bmax121/APatch)
